BaseTen.why: BaseTen lists one deepseek-v4.1-flash offering twice under baseten/fp8 - the global endpoint the account reaches and a dearer US in-region twin (cache read 0.007 against 0.03 per million) - alike in everything else but a 1-token max_completion_tokens listing artifact (32767 against 32768), recorded here as ignored. baseten/fast is a separate tier under its own tag, excluded by the pin. Taking the cheaper: it prices lowest on the cheapest rule's first key (cache read), and every rise of the cheap row is reported as a possible twin switch.
